er_dual_plaque_desc: 放进橱窗后，认识莉迪亚的客人会更愿意进来看看。放在仓库或随身背包里不会生效。
Display it in the showcase to bring in customers who know Lydia. It has no effect in storage or your backpack.
er_dual_plaque_flavor: 底座背面刻着一行小字：莉迪亚，替朋友说话。
A small line is engraved on the back: Lydia, speaking up for a friend.
er_dual_biz_first_intro: 我是莉迪亚介绍来的。听说你这儿有适合送上层的精品？我今天的预算大约 {0} 信用点。合适的话，我按店里的规矩买。
Lydia sent me. I heard you have something fine enough for the Upper Levels. My budget today is about {0} credits. If it suits, I'll buy it the usual way.
er_dual_biz_first_close: 东西我拿走了。她推荐得没错。
I'll take it. She recommended the right place.
er_dual_biz_first_no_trade: 今天没看到合适的。我下次再来。
Nothing suitable today. I'll come back another time.
er_dual_biz_second_intro: 莉迪亚说你能找到便携净水器。预算 {0} 信用点，耐久至少要有 {1}。东西先给我看，价钱照常谈。
Lydia said you can find a portable water purifier. Budget {0} credits, at least {1} durability. Show me the item first; we'll negotiate the price normally.
er_dual_biz_second_close: This will do. Worth the trip.
er_dual_biz_second_no_trade: 没有合适的就先算了。莉迪亚说你这儿还能再问。
If there's nothing suitable, never mind. Lydia said I can ask again here.
er_dual_biz_feedback_notice: 两笔引荐都做成了。莉迪亚的铭牌开始带来更多上层客人。
Both referrals went through. Lydia's plaque is bringing in more Upper Level customers.
er_dual_plaque_full: 你身上和店里都腾不出位置。先清理空间，铭牌之后可以补领。
There is no room in your inventory or shop. Make space and the plaque can be reissued later.
er_dual_notice_ending: 三个人的关系已经稳定下来。之后可以在日常来访中继续见到她们。
The three of you have settled into something steady. You can keep seeing them in everyday visits.
